propositions: When structured parse retries exhaust in _pai_structured prompted branch, the raw reply is discarded making diagnosis unreplayable; opt-in artifact capture is needed.

Config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (None by default, env REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR) when set triggers write of timestamped file containing response text, model id, contract name, and attempt count to that directory.
Artifact write is best-effort and local-only: defaults to no-op, never written to durable store, and any I/O error is swallowed so the original parse error is raised unchanged.
Directory is auto-created if absent; oldest-by-mtime artifacts are pruned to keep at most 20 per directory to prevent unbounded growth.

Key resolves via LLMConfig.from_env using _llm_str pattern in src/rebar/llm/config.py reserved section (not core config); failure hook reads via resolve_gate_config on the prompted-branch failure path before raise.
Artifact path is appended to the raised error message; successful parses never reach the hook and write nothing.
